verdicts.reason: Both use the same bad crop of the photo: the cross and crucifix, which are the key image, are cut down to an unreadable fragment of a hand and a strip of wood. The thin frame border is also gone, so neither still reads as the same Easter design. Both put 'Easter' and 'CHURCH SERVICE' in the lower middle with nearly identical type. 'Easter' runs almost edge to edge in A and has very slightly more side margin in B. Apart from that they are effectively the same.
